name: Julian Ratticulus
source:
Occupation: Stuck on a well??

Skills/Abilities: Things seem to die wherever he goes.

Notes: He seems to speak in strange tongues. But I still haven't figured out where he is from.
He likes to stare and walk behind everyone like a shadow. 

I need to do something about his hair getting stuck everywhere!!
